parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by SKU, name, or barcode

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with - for descending (e.g. -sku). Allowed: sku, name, barcode, type, created_at, updated_at, inventory_total, inventory_available, average_cost

parameters.name: included[]
parameters.description: Columns to include in response. Repeat for multiple.

parameters.name: excluded[]
parameters.description: Columns to exclude. Cannot be used with included[].

parameters.name: filter[type]
parameters.description: Filter by product type: standard, bundle, kit, matrix

parameters.name: filter[supplier]
parameters.description: Filter by supplier name or ID

parameters.name: supplier_id
parameters.description: Filter variations shown in the response to those belonging to a specific supplier
